description:
List files and documentation paths in a known package, repository, or site. Use this for names and structure; skip it when a usable path or symbol is known, and avoid whole-project enumeration for narrow lookups. Package targets cover their package tree; repositories cover the snapshot; both include source and docs. Hosted docs need an explicit site target from the user or a docs search result. Reuse returned read actions; paginate only for needed paths. In site text, a path without trailing / is a page, even if its source URL ends with /.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

after.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from a prior list response. Reuse the same target, paths, filters, recursion, and limit; empty is omitted.

file_types.description: File classes such as source or doc, not languages or extensions. For JavaScript use languages:["javascript"] or paths:["**/*.js"], never file_types:["javascript"]. Source inventories only; case-insensitive.

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON exposes exact entry kinds/actions.

intents.description: Source inventories only; filter by file intent: PRODUCTION, TEST, BENCHMARK, EXAMPLE, GENERATED, FIXTURE, BUILD, or VENDOR.

languages.description: Source inventories only; language names such as `javascript`, `typescript`, or `rust`, case-insensitive.

paths.description: Omit or pass [] to browse the root; never pass blank entries. Package/repository paths are relative: do not use / for their root. Literal paths and globs form a union. Only site paths accept a leading /; / selects the site root.

recursive.description: Expand selected directories to descendant leaves. Without this, selected directories show immediate children. Glob depth is independent of recursion.

target.description: Known package such as `npm:express@5.2.1`, repository such as `github:expressjs/express` or `launchpad:~owner/+git/repo` (`lp:PROJECT` also accepted), or hosted docs site such as `site:expressjs.com`.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait for indexing in milliseconds (0-300000; default 30000).

name: list
